units: <cite ref="Shabbat 150b:9">Sabb. 150ᵇ</cite> <he>למִיגְזָא ליה אסא</he> (Ms. M. <he>למיגז</he>, v. <cite ref="C00538"><he>גְּזַז</he></cite>) to cut a myrtle branch for one (attending a wedding, Rashi <cite ref="O01410"><he>לה</he></cite> for the bride); <cite ref="Shabbat 150b:10">ib.</cite> <he>למיגזא ליה גלימא</he> (Ms. M. <he>למיגז</he>, Ar. s. v. <cite ref="C00151"><he>גד</he></cite>: <he>למיגד</he> ‘to cut’, v. <cite ref="C00166"><he>גדד</he></cite>, or ‘to sew’, v. <cite ref="A00240"><he>אֲגַד</he> I</cite>) to cut a shroud for the dead; <cite ref="Beitzah 6a:4">Bets. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>למיגז</he> (Ms. M. <he>למיגד</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:16">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite> (prov.) when the camel asked for horns, <he>אודנין דהוו ליה גָּזְיִין מיניה</he> they cut off the ears he had.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 96a:1">Ib. 96ᵃ</cite> <he>אִיגְזְיָיךְ אנא</he> I myself will cut thy hair.
<cite ref="Sukkah 37b:5">Succ. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>אתי למִגְזַיֵּיה</he> he may be induced to cut it (Ms. M. <he>למיכל … למיתלש</he>).

<cite ref="Gittin 3a:9">Gitt. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>אתי למיגזייה</he> he may cut it short, i.e. say only a portion of a lengthy legal formula, v. <cite ref="C00338"><he>גּוּז</he></cite>. Y. ib. V, 47ᵇ top <he>ומה דאת גָּזֵי גְזֵי</he> and what crop thou mayest cut, cut, i.e. enjoy the crop as my tenant; a. e.

senses.gloss: to pass, go out of one’s way.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 111b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>וגזי לה</he> (Ms. M. <he>גייז ליה</he>, v. <cite ref="C00338"><he>גּוּז</he></cite>) he went out of the demon’s way.—

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 8:6">Targ. Jer. VIII, 6</cite> <he>דגָזְיָא</he> Ar. s. v. <he>גז</he> 4 (ed. <he>גזר</he>, corr. <cite ref="C00541"><he>גזי</he></cite>) which passes swiftly (h. text <cite ref="U00389"><he>שוטף</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to deal out, dispense, repay. Pesik. Zakhor p. 24ᵇ [read:] למִיגְזֵי לטבא טיבותיה ולמ׳ לבישא בישותיה (v. Bub. note 68 sq.) to repay the good man his goodness &c.; Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 6 למזגיה (corr. acc.); ed. Bub. ib.; Treat. Sof’rim XIV, 7 למזגא, למגוא (corr. acc.); Yalk. Ps. 719.—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:6:4">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᶜ</cite> top <he>וגזי ליה</he> and he (R. Ba bar Zabda) retaliated to him (R. Elazar) his refutation; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:4:6">Y. Meg. I, 70ᶜ</cite> top <he>וגזה ליה</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 44:13">Targ. Is. XLIV, 13</cite>.
